trajectory: Original539d151frame nativecontact-refined geometry q/pose, never warmseed frame0 spliced into trajectory
quaternion: wxyz; validate norms<=1e-6 then explicitly normalize numerical roundoff, sign continuity by consecutive nonnegative dot; shortest relative SO3log, never quaternion-component filtering

primary_rawFD.COM_v: centered second-order firstdifference; endpoints second-order3point one-sided
primary_rawFD.world_omega: interior log(R[i+1] R[i-1]^T)/(2dt); endpoints 1.5*adjacent worldlog interval minus .5*next interval (and mirrored at end)
primary_rawFD.world_alpha: second-order firstdifference of worldomega; endpoints3point one-sided
primary_rawFD.endpoint_scope: Designed finite differences, sensitive to boundary/extrapolation/noise, not measured velocities/accelerations or force

fixed_sensitivity.rotation: Savitzky-Golay raw worldomega derivatives0/1; original rotation used for Iworld. Not a fully reconstructed smoothed orientation trajectory.

wrench.mass_inertia: Fixed actualcontext mass/inertia/body_iquat; unchanged nominal body_ipos COM offset
wrench.gravity: Installed model opt.gravity, known simulator prior; not source camera gravity measurement

screen.contacts: All actual native filtered hand-object generated contact records, native material/condim/priority; any positive contactdist retained and explicitly flagged as potential-contact relaxation, not measured load
screen.cone: Installed native pyramidal edges incl condim4 torsion, no normal uppercap, torque row scale.01m; pinned existing helper
screen.absent: No generated nativecontact => empty available cone for this screen, absent pair gap remainsUNKNOWN/NaN. Not measured separation or gap0
screen.scope: Object-only wrench existence at fixed per-frame geometric q/objectpose. No robot/PD/selfcontact force equilibrium, constitutive contact force, dynamics or continuous trajectory qualification.

selection: All151 frames and all3 conditions retained, no tuning/success selection, no frame-level independent sample claim
